cues.text: Hello, little harvester! Listen for the fruit or vegetable. Bring the matching harvest to your basket. You can drag it, or touch it and then touch the basket.
You picked our lovely harvest! Look at those full baskets. Thank you, little farmer. What a wonderful helper!
Can you find the apples? Bring the apples to your basket.
Let's pick the strawberries. Bring the strawberries to your basket.
Can you find the pears? Bring the pears to your basket.
Let's pick the carrots. Bring the carrots to your basket.
Can you find the corn? Bring the corn to your basket.
Let's pick the potatoes. Bring the potatoes to your basket.
Our farm friends need some shopping! Listen to the order, then move the harvest into the basket in the same order. You can hear it again whenever you like.
Every order is packed and delivered! Our farm friends are so happy. Lovely listening, little helper!
Let's help our friends get home! Hens like the cosy coop. Cows rest in the barn. Sheep and goats like the grassy paddock. Move each friend to their home.
Everyone is home and cosy! You looked after our farm friends so well. Thank you, little helper!
Let's sort our fresh harvest! Move the fruit into the fruit basket, and the vegetables into the vegetable basket. The little pictures will help you.
All sorted! Our fruit and vegetables are ready for the market. You did a wonderful job!
Apple.
Strawberry.
Pear.
Carrot.
Corn.
Potato.
Let's count our apples together! Pick every apple from the little tree and bring it to the basket. Then choose the number that tells us how many.
Now all the apples are in the basket. How many did we pick? Move the matching number onto the little label.
Picked, counted and labelled! You counted our harvest so carefully. Great counting, little farmer!
Let's weigh our apple baskets! Put one basket on each side of the scales. Then look carefully. Which basket has more apples?
Both baskets are on the scales. The fuller basket goes lower. Touch the basket that has more apples.
You found the fuller basket every time! More apples make a heavier basket. Great comparing, little farmer!
One.
Two.
Three.
Four.
Five.
